summary: Iteration 52: validated (A) 1000-product shop seed across Amazon/Walmart/JD.com/Alibaba/Temu with retailer-specific affiliate URLs and (B) Web Push (VAPID) subscribe/unsubscribe flow + push firing on job accept and tracking updates. All 13 pytest cases in tests/test_iter52_shop_seed_push.py pass (backend 100%). Frontend /shop, Settings toggle-push, and admin edit regression verified via Playwright + curl. OrderService PushOptInCard verified by code review + testid presence (rendering requires the wizard success state which is expensive to reach end-to-end in test).

ui_bugs.issue: When browser blocks ServiceWorker/Notification (headless / real user with permission just flipped to denied), enablePush() throws 'Registration failed - permission denied' which surfaces as a React dev overlay rather than a user-friendly toast. Wrap enablePush in try/catch inside Settings.togglePush and rely on toast (already imported) so the error is caught gracefully.

issues: Retailer 'All' chip label shows '(200)' when no retailer filter is active — appears to reflect the current page limit rather than the full catalog total (1001). Consider labeling as 'All (1001)' by summing retailer counts or using the total from /api/shop/products.

action_items: Optional: catch enablePush() throws in Settings.togglePush and surface via toast to prevent dev-overlay pop-ups if a user's OS/browser permission flips to denied mid-flow.
Optional UX polish: /shop 'All' retailer chip count should show the true catalog total (1001) instead of the page-limit sample (200).
critical_code_review_comments: push_notifications.send_push_to_user correctly imports pywebpush lazily and prunes dead 404/410 subs — good defensive coding.
shop_seed_1000.seed_1000_products is idempotent (checks >=900 existing) and wipes older seed_batches before reseeding — safe on repeated boots.
server.py wires _send_push_to_user inside try/except at both /jobs/{id}/accept and /jobs/{id}/tracking so push failures never break the API — correct.
push_subscriptions has unique index on endpoint and $set upsert on POST /api/push/subscribe — duplicate subscribe correctly upserts (verified).
shop_seed_1000._image_for computes an unused `hid` variable — harmless but dead code.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (shop + settings toggle-push verified; OrderService success screen verified by testid presence in source; end-to-end wizard flow not exercised)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test at /app/backend/tests/test_iter52_shop_seed_push.py covers full shop seed + push subscribe/unsubscribe/status + a direct send_push_to_user helper test that monkeypatches pywebpush.webpush. Push firing on accept/tracking is proven at the helper level; server routes call the same helper. Playwright cannot subscribe in Chromium headless because Notification.permission is 'denied' at the OS level; overriding via add_init_script + Notification.permission getter gets the /api/push/public-key call to fire but service-worker.pushManager.subscribe still fails — this is a headless limitation, not a code bug.
